content.value: Water from a stationary nozzle strikes a flat plate as shown. The water leaves the nozzle at 15 m/sec; the nozzle area is 0.01 m². Assuming the water is directed ${ \bf { \dot { m } } } ^ { 2 } .$ normal to the plate and flows along the plate, determine the horizontal force needed by a person to hold it in place. Adopt integral approach to solve the problem.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
